summary: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting preliminary unaudited results for the first quarter of 2026. The filing presents consolidated and separate financial metrics, including operating revenue of KRW 43,923 billion, operating income of KRW 5,376 billion, and profit attributable to controlling interests of KRW 3,224 billion, with year-over-year comparisons. No corporate event, transaction, or special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer.
